# 建模步骤
## 数据初步清洗

1. 读取并合并数据
2. 变量重命名：内在能力及其相关变量，包括出生年份、性别等都重命名
3. 年龄数据清洗：去掉非老年人的个体之后9982人
## 内在能力赋值

### 1. 运动
- 2.5米步行速度≥ 1米/秒得1分；
- 重复坐下5次≤12秒得1分；
- 平衡：3个10秒完成2个及以上得1分。
- 满分3分

### 2. 认知
- 情景记忆（基于延迟回忆得分）：0-10分；
- 减7测试：5分；
- 日期、月份、年份和季节：5分；
- 绘画：1分。
- 满分21分 
- 按四分位数分为0、1、2、3四个分数（还是用线性变换）
- 满分3分

### 3. 心理
- CES-D评分为0到9分：得1分；
- 总睡眠时间在5到10.5小时之间，得1分；
- 睡眠质量：一周内睡眠不安的频率0到2天之间得1分。
- 满分3分

### 4.  感官
- 听力回答非常好、好、一般：得1分；
- 视力回答非常好、好、一般：得1分（远和近两项）
- 满分3分

### 5.  活力
- 握力：男性≥ 35kg得1分，女性≥ 25kg得1分；
- FEV：男性≥ 400得1分，女性≥ 290得1分;
- 血红蛋白：男性≥ 120g/L得1分，女性≥ 110g/L得1分。
- 满分3分

## 内在能力筛选
- 根据内在能力计算情况筛选出覆盖内在能力指标100%的个体
- 保存筛选后的数据到一个新的数据框中  

## 自变量筛选与清洗
### 经验手动筛选
1. 导出原始数据
2. 提取原始数据中的变量名和变量标签，作为两个变量，再加上是否纳入和备注导出为csv
3. 每个类型的数据表单独导出一个工作表
4. 进行手动筛选，筛选出需要的变量（主要根据其临床意义和是否可测算进行筛选）
    - 收入算个人，财产算家庭
    - 再去思考一下bracket的意义
    - 所有的yes再核对
    - 给变量列表加上备注，标出这部分变量的类别
    - 没有观察值的直接排除
5. 将筛选后的数据导出
6. 按照手动筛选出的变量名对原始数据进行清洗，去除不需要的变量，保留内在能力相关变量

### 自变量计算
1. 按照纳入的每个指标附属条目计算出每个指标的最终分数（其中仔细考虑NA和非空0值的意义）
2. 将计算的自变量重新命名
   

### 缺失值变量筛选
1. 如果某个变量缺失值大于20%，则删除该变量
   
### 算法筛选

1. 采用boruta方法进行算法筛选（可boruta方法需要进行筛选，）
2. 计算多重共线性筛选

## 模型选择
1. 多元线性回归
2. KNN
3. 随机森林
4. 支持向量机
5. 神经网络
6. 极端梯度提升树

## 读取并合并数据
```{r 读取并合并数据}
files <- list.files("data_raw/2015/self", pattern = "\\.dta$", full.names = TRUE)
data_list <- lapply(files, read_dta)
my_data_raw <- Reduce(function(x, y) {
    merged <- full_join(x, y, by = "ID", suffix = c("", ".dup"))
    dups <- grep("\\.dup$", names(merged), value = TRUE)
    merged <- merged %>% select(-all_of(dups))
    merged
}, data_list)
```

## 年龄数据清洗
```{r 年龄数据清洗}
# 去除实际出生年份和ID出生年份同时缺失的数据
my_data_year_na <- my_data_rename %>%
    filter(!(is.na(actual_birth_year) & is.na(id_birth_year)))

# 计算年龄值
my_data_age <- my_data_year_na %>%
    mutate(age = 2015 - coalesce(actual_birth_year, id_birth_year))

# 年龄清洗
my_data_elder <- my_data_age %>%
    filter(age >= 60)

# 输出现在总共多少人
total_individuals <- nrow(my_data_elder)
print(paste("总共人数:", total_individuals))

my_data_wash <- my_data_elder
```
## 内在能力分数计算
### 运动维度计算
```{r 运动维度计算}
# 计算步行测试时间（无误）
my_data_wash <- my_data_wash %>%
    mutate(
        final_walk_time = case_when(
            walk_time_first == 993 & walk_time_second == 993 ~ 0,
            (is.na(walk_time_first) & is.na(walk_time_second)) | (walk_time_first == 999 & walk_time_second == 999) | (is.na(walk_time_first) & walk_time_second == 999) | (walk_time_first == 999 & is.na(walk_time_second)) ~ case_when(
                rowSums(select(., starts_with("walk_test_reason_")) == 4, na.rm = TRUE) > 0 ~ 0,
                rowSums(select(., starts_with("walk_test_reason_")) == 6, na.rm = TRUE) > 0 ~ 0,
                TRUE ~ NA_real_
            ),
            TRUE ~ case_when(
                walk_test_aid == 1 ~ if_else(2.5 / pmin(walk_time_first, walk_time_second, na.rm = TRUE) >= 1, 1, 0),
                walk_test_aid %in% c(2, 3, 4, 97) ~ 0,
                TRUE ~ NA_real_
            )
        )
    )

# 计算步行速度
my_data_wash <- my_data_wash %>%
    mutate(
        walking_speed = case_when(
            walk_time_first == 993 & walk_time_second == 993 ~ 0,
            (is.na(walk_time_first) & is.na(walk_time_second)) | (walk_time_first == 999 & walk_time_second == 999) | (is.na(walk_time_first) & walk_time_second == 999) | (walk_time_first == 999 & is.na(walk_time_second)) ~ case_when(
                rowSums(select(., starts_with("walk_test_reason_")) == 4, na.rm = TRUE) > 0 ~ 0,
                rowSums(select(., starts_with("walk_test_reason_")) == 6, na.rm = TRUE) > 0 ~ 0,
                TRUE ~ NA_real_
            ),
            TRUE ~ 2.5 / pmin(walk_time_first, walk_time_second, na.rm = TRUE)
        )
    )

# 计算最终步行得分
my_data_wash <- my_data_wash %>%
    mutate(
        final_walk_time = case_when(
            is.na(walking_speed) ~ NA_real_,
            walk_test_aid == 1 ~ if_else(walking_speed >= 1, 1, 0),
            walk_test_aid %in% c(2, 3, 4, 97) ~ 0,
            TRUE ~ NA_real_
        )
    )
```

```{r 心理维度计算}
                            depression_scale_8 == 2 ~ 2,
                            depression_scale_8 == 3 ~ 1,
                            depression_scale_8 == 4 ~ 0,
                            TRUE ~ 0
                        )
                    ),
                na.rm = TRUE
            )
        )
    ) %>%

)
```

```{r 自变量及其标签导出}
# 提取出原始数据中所有变量标签

# 将 NULL 元素替换为空字符串
variable_labels[sapply(variable_labels, is.null)] <- ""
# 将变量标签转换为字符向量
variable_labels_values <- unlist(variable_labels)
# 导出变量标签
variable_labels <- data.frame(
    variable = names(my_data_raw),

)

wb <- createWorkbook()

addWorksheet(wb, "Variable Labels")
writeData(wb, "Variable Labels", variable_labels)

# 保存Excel文件
saveWorkbook(wb, "data_export/data_manual_filter/variable_labels.xlsx", overwrite = TRUE)
```

```{r 临床经验筛选}
# 读取变量列表

# 内在能力相关变量

    "final_physical_score",  # 运动维度分数
    "cognitive_level",       # 认知维度分数
    "final_psychological_score", # 心理维度分数
    "final_sensory_score",   # 感官维度分数

)

# 合并需要保留的变量
vars_to_keep <- c(ic_vars, selected_vars)

my_data_manual_filtered <- my_data_filtered_100_ic %>%
    select(any_of(vars_to_keep))

write_parquet(my_data_manual_filtered, "data_export/data_manual_filter/my_data_manual_filtered.parquet")
```

```{r 人口学数据计算}
# 查看手动筛选数据中有多少个观察值
nrow(my_data_manual_filtered)

# 读取2011年和2013年人口学数据
demo_2013 <- read_dta("data_raw/2013/self/Demographic_Background.dta")
demo_2011 <- read_dta("data_raw/2011/self/demographic_background.dta")

# 转换2011年数据中的ID变量
demo_2011 <- demo_2011 %>%
    mutate(
        # 创建新的ID变量
        ID = paste0(
            householdID,  # 使用householdID
            "0",          # 添加"0"
            substr(as.character(ID), nchar(as.character(ID))-1, nchar(as.character(ID)))  # 获取原ID的最后两位
        )
    )

# 从2011年数据中选择匹配的观察值
demo_matched_2011 <- demo_2011 %>%
    filter(ID %in% my_data_manual_filtered$ID)

# 从2013年数据中选择匹配的观察值
demo_matched_2013 <- demo_2013 %>%
    filter(ID %in% my_data_manual_filtered$ID)
nrow(demo_matched_2013)

# 计算户口ID（没问题）
my_data_calculated <- my_data_calculated %>%
    mutate(
        householdID = my_data_manual_filtered$householdID
    )
attr(my_data_calculated$householdID, "label") <- "户口ID"

# 计算社区ID（没问题）
my_data_calculated <- my_data_calculated %>%
    mutate(
        communityID = my_data_manual_filtered$communityID
    )
attr(my_data_calculated$communityID, "label") <- "社区ID"

# 计算性别（没问题）
my_data_calculated <- my_data_calculated %>%
    mutate(
        gender = factor(my_data_manual_filtered$xrgender, 
                       levels = c(1, 2),
                       labels = c("男", "女"))
    )
attr(my_data_calculated$gender, "label") <- "性别"
table(my_data_calculated$gender, useNA = "always")


# 计算居住类型（没问题）
my_data_calculated <- my_data_calculated %>%
    mutate(
        address_type = factor(
            case_when(
                is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$bb001_w3_1) ~ NA_real_,
                my_data_manual_filtered$bb001_w3_1 == 1 ~ 1,  # 城市住宅
                my_data_manual_filtered$bb001_w3_1 == 2 ~ 2,  # 农村住宅
                my_data_manual_filtered$bb001_w3_1 == 3 ~ 3,  # 养老院/疗养院
                my_data_manual_filtered$bb001_w3_1 == 4 ~ 4,  # 其他
                TRUE ~ NA_real_
            ),
            levels = c(1, 2, 3, 4),
            labels = c("城市住宅", "农村住宅", "养老院/疗养院", "其他")
        )
    )
attr(my_data_calculated$address_type, "label") <- "居住类型"
table(my_data_calculated$address_type, useNA = "always")


# 计算城乡地址
my_data_calculated <- my_data_calculated %>%
    mutate(
        address_urban_or_rural = factor(
            case_when(
                is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$bb001_w3_2) ~ NA_real_,
                my_data_manual_filtered$bb001_w3_2 == 1 ~ 1,  # 主城区
                my_data_manual_filtered$bb001_w3_2 == 2 ~ 2,  # 城乡结合部
                my_data_manual_filtered$bb001_w3_2 == 3 ~ 3,  # 镇中心
                my_data_manual_filtered$bb001_w3_2 == 4 ~ 4,  # 镇乡
                my_data_manual_filtered$bb001_w3_2 == 5 ~ 5,  # 特殊区域
                my_data_manual_filtered$bb001_w3_2 == 6 ~ 6,  # 乡中心
                my_data_manual_filtered$bb001_w3_2 == 7 ~ 7,  # 村庄
                TRUE ~ NA_real_
            ),
            levels = c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7),
            labels = c("主城区", "城乡结合部", "镇中心", "镇乡", "特殊区域", "乡中心", "村庄")
        )
    )
attr(my_data_calculated$address_urban_or_rural, "label") <- "城乡地址"
table(my_data_calculated$address_urban_or_rural, useNA = "always")

# 计算省份
my_data_calculated <- my_data_calculated %>%
    mutate(
        address_province = factor(
            case_when(
                is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$bb001_w3) ~ NA_real_,
                my_data_manual_filtered$bb001_w3 == 1 ~ 1,
                my_data_manual_filtered$bb001_w3 == 2 ~ 2,
                my_data_manual_filtered$bb001_w3 == 3 ~ 3,
                TRUE ~ NA_real_
            ),
            levels = c(1, 2, 3),
            labels = c("和户口一致", "户口外其他省份", "国外")
        )
    )
attr(my_data_calculated$address_province, "label") <- "省份"
table(my_data_calculated$address_province, useNA = "always")

# 计算婚姻状况（没问题）
my_data_calculated <- my_data_calculated %>%
    mutate(
        martial_status = factor(
            case_when(
                is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$be001) ~ NA_real_,
                my_data_manual_filtered$be001 == 1 ~ 1,  # 已婚与配偶一同居住
                my_data_manual_filtered$be001 == 2 ~ 2,  # 已婚但配偶暂时不在一起居住
                my_data_manual_filtered$be001 == 3 ~ 3,  # 已婚但配偶在外地工作
                my_data_manual_filtered$be001 == 4 ~ 4,  # 离异
                my_data_manual_filtered$be001 == 5 ~ 5,  # 丧偶
                my_data_manual_filtered$be001 == 6 ~ 6,  # 从未结婚
                my_data_manual_filtered$be001 == 7 ~ 7,  # 同居
                TRUE ~ NA_real_
            ),
            levels = c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7),
            labels = c("已婚与配偶一同居住", "已婚但配偶暂时不在一起居住", "已婚但配偶在外地工作", 
                      "离异", "丧偶", "从未结婚", "同居")
        )
    )
attr(my_data_calculated$martial_status, "label") <- "婚姻状况"
table(my_data_calculated$martial_status, useNA = "always")

# 计算教育水平（没问题）
my_data_calculated <- my_data_calculated %>%
    mutate(
        education_level = factor(
            case_when(
                # 处理bd011为1/2/3且bd001_w2_4<7的情况
                my_data_manual_filtered$bd011 == 1 & !is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$bd001_w2_4) & my_data_manual_filtered$bd001_w2_4 < 7 ~ 7,
                my_data_manual_filtered$bd011 == 2 & !is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$bd001_w2_4) & my_data_manual_filtered$bd001_w2_4 < 7 ~ 8,
                my_data_manual_filtered$bd011 == 3 & !is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$bd001_w2_4) & my_data_manual_filtered$bd001_w2_4 < 7 ~ 9,
                
                # 处理bd011为4或NA，且bd001_w2_4为NA的情况
                (my_data_manual_filtered$bd011 == 4 | is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$bd011)) & is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$bd001_w2_4) ~ NA_real_,
                
                # 处理bd011为NA，且bd001_w2_4不为12的情况
                is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$bd011) & !is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$bd001_w2_4) & my_data_manual_filtered$bd001_w2_4 != 12 ~ as.numeric(my_data_manual_filtered$bd001_w2_4),
                
                # 处理bd011为NA，且bd001_w2_4为12的情况
                is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$bd011) & my_data_manual_filtered$bd001_w2_4 == 12 ~ case_when(
                    # 检查2013年数据
                    ID %in% demo_matched_2013$ID & !is.na(demo_matched_2013$bd001_w2_4[match(ID, demo_matched_2013$ID)]) & 
                    demo_matched_2013$bd001_w2_4[match(ID, demo_matched_2013$ID)] != 12 ~ 
                    as.numeric(demo_matched_2013$bd001_w2_4[match(ID, demo_matched_2013$ID)]),
                    
                    # 如果2013年数据不满足条件，检查2011年数据
                    ID %in% demo_matched_2011$ID & !is.na(demo_matched_2011$bd001[match(ID, demo_matched_2011$ID)]) ~ 
                    as.numeric(demo_matched_2011$bd001[match(ID, demo_matched_2011$ID)]),
                    
                    # 如果都不满足，返回NA
                    TRUE ~ NA_real_
                ),
                
                # 其他情况返回NA
                TRUE ~ NA_real_
            ),
            ordered = TRUE, # 添加ordered参数使其成为有序因子
            levels = 1:11,
            labels = c("文盲", "未读完小学", "私塾毕业", "小学毕业", "初中毕业", 
                      "高中毕业", "中专毕业", "大专毕业", "本科毕业", 
                      "硕士毕业", "博士毕业")
        )
    )
attr(my_data_calculated$education_level, "label") <- "教育水平"
table(my_data_calculated$education_level, useNA = "always")

# 计算是否识字（没问题）
my_data_calculated <- my_data_calculated %>%
    mutate(
        literate = case_when(
            # 如果教育水平高于文盲
            education_level %in% c("未读完小学", "私塾毕业", "小学毕业", "初中毕业", 
                                 "高中毕业", "中专毕业", "大专毕业", "本科毕业", 
                                 "硕士毕业", "博士毕业") ~ 1,
            # 如果是文盲，则根据bd001_w3_1判断
            education_level == "文盲" ~ case_when(
                my_data_manual_filtered$bd001_w3_1 == 1 ~ 1,
                TRUE ~ 0
            ),
            # 其他情况
            TRUE ~ NA_real_
        )
    )
attr(my_data_calculated$literate, "label") <- "是否识字"
table(my_data_calculated$literate, useNA = "always")

# 导出人口学数据
demographic_data <- my_data_calculated %>%
    select(ID, householdID, communityID, gender, address_type, address_urban_or_rural, address_province, literate, martial_status, education_level, age)
# 导出人口学数据为parquet
write_parquet(demographic_data, "data_export/data_calculated/parquet/data_calculated_demographic.parquet")
# 导出人口学数据为csv
write.csv(demographic_data, "data_export/data_calculated/csv/data_calculated_demographic.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r 家庭结构计算}
# 计算亲生父母是否健在（没问题）
my_data_calculated <- my_data_calculated %>%
    mutate(
        biological_parents_alive = case_when(
            # 如果两个变量都是NA，返回NA
            is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$ca000_w3_2_1_) & 
            is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$ca001_w3_2_1_) ~ NA_real_,
            # 否则计算非NA值的总和
            TRUE ~ rowSums(
                select(my_data_manual_filtered, ca000_w3_2_1_, ca001_w3_2_1_) %>%
                mutate_all(~case_when(
                    . == 1 ~ 1,  # 取值为1记为1
                    . == 2 ~ 0,  # 取值为2记为0
                    TRUE ~ NA_real_  # 其他值记为NA
                )),
                na.rm = TRUE  # 忽略NA值
            )
        )
    )
attr(my_data_calculated$biological_parents_alive, "label") <- "亲生父母健在数量"
table(my_data_calculated$biological_parents_alive, useNA = "ifany")

# 计算配偶亲生父母健在数量（没问题）
my_data_calculated <- my_data_calculated %>%
    mutate(
        spouse_biological_parents_alive = case_when(
            # 如果两个变量都是NA，返回NA
            is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$ca000_w3_2_2_) & 
            is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$ca001_w3_2_2_) ~ NA_real_,
            # 否则计算非NA值的总和
            TRUE ~ rowSums(
                select(my_data_manual_filtered, ca000_w3_2_2_, ca001_w3_2_2_) %>%
                mutate_all(~case_when(
                    . == 1 ~ 1,  # 取值为1记为1
                    . == 2 ~ 0,  # 取值为2记为0
                    TRUE ~ NA_real_  # 其他值记为NA
                )),
                na.rm = TRUE  # 忽略NA值
            )
        )
    )
attr(my_data_calculated$spouse_biological_parents_alive, "label") <- "配偶亲生父母健在数量"

# 计算父母是否离异（没问题）
my_data_calculated <- my_data_calculated %>%
    mutate(
        parents_divorced = case_when(
            my_data_manual_filtered$ca002_w3_1_1_ == 1 ~ 1,
            my_data_manual_filtered$ca002_w3_1_1_ == 2 ~ 0,
            TRUE ~ NA_real_
        )
    )
attr(my_data_calculated$parents_divorced, "label") <- "父母是否离异"

# 计算子女总数（没问题）
my_data_calculated <- my_data_calculated %>%
    mutate(
        num_children = my_data_manual_filtered$xchildnum
    )
attr(my_data_calculated$num_children, "label") <- "子女总数"

# 计算健在子女数量（没问题）
my_data_calculated <- my_data_calculated %>%
    mutate(
        totalnum_children_alive = case_when(
            is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$xchildnum_alive) & is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$cb051_w3_1) ~ NA_real_,
            TRUE ~ coalesce(my_data_manual_filtered$xchildnum_alive, 0) + coalesce(my_data_manual_filtered$cb051_w3_1, 0)
        )
    )
attr(my_data_calculated$totalnum_children_alive, "label") <- "健在子女数量"

# 计算去世子女数量（没问题）
my_data_calculated <- my_data_calculated %>%
    mutate(
        num_children_dead = case_when(
            is.na(num_children) | is.na(totalnum_children_alive) ~ NA_real_,
            TRUE ~ num_children - totalnum_children_alive
        )
    )
attr(my_data_calculated$num_children_dead, "label") <- "死亡子女数量"

# 计算死亡子女比例
my_data_calculated <- my_data_calculated %>%
    mutate(
        dead_children_ratio = case_when(
            is.na(num_children_dead) | is.na(totalnum_children_alive) ~ NA_real_,
            num_children == 0 ~ 0,
            TRUE ~ num_children_dead / totalnum_children_alive
        )
    )
attr(my_data_calculated$dead_children_ratio, "label") <- "死亡子女比例"

# 计算已婚子女数量及比例（没问题）
my_data_calculated <- my_data_calculated %>%
    mutate(
        num_children_married = case_when(
            # 检查是否所有值都是NA
            all(is.na(select(my_data_manual_filtered, starts_with("cb063_")))) ~ NA_real_,
            # 否则计算非NA值的总和
            TRUE ~ rowSums(
                select(my_data_manual_filtered, starts_with("cb063_")) %>%
                mutate_all(~case_when(
                    . == 1 ~ 1,  # 已婚记为1
                    !is.na(.) ~ 0,  # 其他非NA值记为0
                    TRUE ~ NA_real_  # NA保持为NA
                )),
                na.rm = TRUE  # 忽略部分NA值
            )
        ),
        married_children_ratio = case_when(
            is.na(num_children_married) | is.na(totalnum_children_alive) ~ NA_real_,
            totalnum_children_alive == 0 ~ 0,
            TRUE ~ num_children_married / totalnum_children_alive
        )
    )
attr(my_data_calculated$married_children_ratio, "label") <- "已婚子女比例"

# 计算孙子女数量（没问题）
my_data_calculated <- my_data_calculated %>%

        total_number_grandchildren = case_when(
            # 检查是否所有值都是NA
            all(is.na(select(my_data_manual_filtered, starts_with("cb065_")))) ~ NA_real_,
            # 否则计算非NA值的总和
            TRUE ~ rowSums(
                select(my_data_manual_filtered, starts_with("cb065_")) %>%
                mutate_all(as.numeric),
                na.rm = TRUE  # 忽略部分NA值
            )
        )
    )
attr(my_data_calculated$total_number_grandchildren, "label") <- "孙子女总数"
table(my_data_calculated$total_number_grandchildren, useNA = "ifany")

# 计算重孙子女数量（没问题）
my_data_calculated <- my_data_calculated %>%
    mutate(
        total_number_great_grandchildren = case_when(
            # 检查是否所有值都是NA
            all(is.na(select(my_data_manual_filtered, starts_with("cb067_")))) ~ NA_real_,
            # 否则计算非NA值的总和
            TRUE ~ rowSums(
                select(my_data_manual_filtered, starts_with("cb067_")) %>%
                mutate_all(as.numeric),
                na.rm = TRUE  # 忽略部分NA值
            )
        )

attr(my_data_calculated$total_number_great_grandchildren, "label") <- "重孙子女总数"

# 计算孙子女和重孙子女总数
my_data_calculated <- my_data_calculated %>%

family_structure_data <- my_data_calculated %>%
```

```{r 照顾负担计算}
# 计算照顾父母数量（没问题）
my_data_calculated <- my_data_calculated %>%
    mutate(
        number_care_parents = case_when(
            # 检查是否所有值都是NA
            all(is.na(select(my_data_manual_filtered, starts_with("ca026_w3_")))) ~ NA_real_,
            # 否则计算非NA值的总和
            TRUE ~ rowSums(
                select(my_data_manual_filtered, starts_with("ca026_w3_")) %>%
                mutate_all(~case_when(
                    . == 1 ~ 0,  # yes记为0
                    . == 2 ~ 1,   # no记为1
                    TRUE ~ NA_real_  # 其他值记为NA
                )),
                na.rm = TRUE  # 忽略部分NA值
            )
        )
    )
attr(my_data_calculated$number_care_parents, "label") <- "照顾父母数量"

# 计算照顾子女数量（没问题）
my_data_calculated <- my_data_calculated %>%
    mutate(
        number_takecare_children = case_when(
            # 检查是否所有值都是NA
            all(is.na(select(my_data_manual_filtered, starts_with("cb063_w3_6_")))) ~ NA_real_,
            # 否则计算非NA值的总和
            TRUE ~ rowSums(
                select(my_data_manual_filtered, starts_with("cb063_w3_6_")) %>%
                mutate_all(~case_when(
                    . == 1 ~ 0,  # yes记为0
                    . == 2 ~ 1,  # no记为1
                    TRUE ~ NA_real_  # 其他值记为NA
                )),
                na.rm = TRUE  # 忽略部分NA值
            )
        )
    )
attr(my_data_calculated$number_takecare_children, "label") <- "照顾子女数量"

# 计算是否带孙子女（没问题）
my_data_calculated <- my_data_calculated %>%
    mutate(
        takecare_grandchildren = case_when(
            is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$cf001) ~ NA_real_,
            my_data_manual_filtered$cf001 == 1 ~ 1,  # yes记为1
            my_data_manual_filtered$cf001 == 2 ~ 0,  # no记为0
            TRUE ~ NA_real_  # 其他值记为NA
        )
    )
attr(my_data_calculated$takecare_grandchildren, "label") <- "是否照顾孙子女"

# 计算照顾孙子女总小时数（没问题）
my_data_calculated <- my_data_calculated %>%
    mutate(
        takecare_grandchildren_hours = case_when(
            # 首先判断是否照顾孙子女
            takecare_grandchildren == 0 ~ 0,
            takecare_grandchildren == 1 ~ case_when(
                # 如果两个数值相乘的结果都是NA，则返回NA
                all(
                    (is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$cf003_1_1_) | is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$cf003_2_1_)) &
                    (is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$cf003_1_2_) | is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$cf003_2_2_)) &
                    (is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$cf003_1_3_) | is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$cf003_2_3_)) &
                    (is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$cf003_1_4_) | is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$cf003_2_4_)) &
                    (is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$cf003_1_5_) | is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$cf003_2_5_)) &
                    (is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$cf003_1_6_) | is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$cf003_2_6_)) &
                    (is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$cf003_1_7_) | is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$cf003_2_7_)) &
                    (is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$cf003_1_8_) | is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$cf003_2_8_)) &
                    (is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$cf003_1_9_) | is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$cf003_2_9_)) &
                    (is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$cf003_1_10_) | is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$cf003_2_10_)) &
                    (is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$cf003_1_11_) | is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$cf003_2_11_)) &
                    (is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$cf003_1_13_) | is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$cf003_2_13_))
                ) ~ NA_real_,
                # 否则计算乘积
                TRUE ~ rowSums(
                    cbind(
                        my_data_manual_filtered$cf003_2_1_ * my_data_manual_filtered$cf003_1_1_,
                        my_data_manual_filtered$cf003_2_2_ * my_data_manual_filtered$cf003_1_2_,
                        my_data_manual_filtered$cf003_2_3_ * my_data_manual_filtered$cf003_1_3_,
                        my_data_manual_filtered$cf003_2_4_ * my_data_manual_filtered$cf003_1_4_,
                        my_data_manual_filtered$cf003_2_5_ * my_data_manual_filtered$cf003_1_5_,
                        my_data_manual_filtered$cf003_2_6_ * my_data_manual_filtered$cf003_1_6_,
                        my_data_manual_filtered$cf003_2_7_ * my_data_manual_filtered$cf003_1_7_,
                        my_data_manual_filtered$cf003_2_8_ * my_data_manual_filtered$cf003_1_8_,
                        my_data_manual_filtered$cf003_2_9_ * my_data_manual_filtered$cf003_1_9_,
                        my_data_manual_filtered$cf003_2_10_ * my_data_manual_filtered$cf003_1_10_,
                        my_data_manual_filtered$cf003_2_11_ * my_data_manual_filtered$cf003_1_11_,
                        my_data_manual_filtered$cf003_2_13_ * my_data_manual_filtered$cf003_1_13_),
                    na.rm = TRUE
                )
            ),
            # 如果takecare_grandchildren是NA，返回NA
            is.na(takecare_grandchildren) ~ NA_real_
        )
    )
attr(my_data_calculated$takecare_grandchildren_hours, "label") <- "照顾孙子女总小时数"

# 计算是否照顾父母（没问题）
my_data_calculated <- my_data_calculated %>%
    mutate(
        takecare_parents = case_when(
            is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$cf004) ~ NA_real_,
            my_data_manual_filtered$cf004 == 1 ~ 1,  # yes记为1
            my_data_manual_filtered$cf004 == 2 ~ 0,  # no记为0
            TRUE ~ NA_real_  # 其他值记为NA
        )
    )
attr(my_data_calculated$takecare_parents, "label") <- "是否照顾父母"
table(my_data_calculated$takecare_parents, useNA = "ifany")

# 计算照顾父母总小时数（没问题）
my_data_calculated <- my_data_calculated %>%
    mutate(
        takecare_parents_hours = case_when(
            # 如果不照顾父母，时间为0
            takecare_parents == 0 ~ 0,
            # 如果照顾父母，计算照顾时间
            takecare_parents == 1 ~ case_when(
                # 检查是否所有相关变量都是NA
                all(
                    (is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$cf005_1) | is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$cf005_2)) &
                    (is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$cf005_3) | is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$cf005_4)) &
                    (is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$cf005_5) | is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$cf005_6)) &
                    (is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$cf005_7) | is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$cf005_8))
                ) ~ NA_real_,
                # 否则计算照顾父母的总时间
                TRUE ~ rowSums(
                    cbind(
                        my_data_manual_filtered$cf005_1 * my_data_manual_filtered$cf005_2,
                        my_data_manual_filtered$cf005_3 * my_data_manual_filtered$cf005_4,
                        my_data_manual_filtered$cf005_5 * my_data_manual_filtered$cf005_6,
                        my_data_manual_filtered$cf005_7 * my_data_manual_filtered$cf005_8
                    ),
                    na.rm = TRUE  # 忽略部分NA值
                )
            ),
            # 如果takecare_parents是NA，返回NA
            TRUE ~ NA_real_
        )
    )
attr(my_data_calculated$takecare_parents_hours, "label") <- "照顾父母总小时数"

        number_takecare_children,       # 照顾子女数量
        takecare_grandchildren,         # 是否照顾孙子女
        takecare_grandchildren_hours,   # 照顾孙子女总小时数
        takecare_parents,               # 是否照顾父母
        takecare_parents_hours         # 照顾父母总小时数
    )
```

```{r 医疗保险计算}
# 计算每个人拥有的医疗保险数量（没问题）
my_data_calculated <- my_data_calculated %>%
    mutate(
        number_medical_insurance = case_when(
            # 如果所有医疗保险变量都是NA，返回NA
            is.na(urban_employee_medical_insurance) & 
            is.na(urban_resident_medical_insurance) &

            is.na(urbanandruralresident_medical_insurance) & 
            is.na(gongfei_medical_insurance) &

            # 否则计算非NA值的总和

                      gongfei_medical_insurance,

                      urban_nonemployed_persons_healthinsuran,

            is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$ef001s1) &

            is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$ef001s3) & 
            is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$ef001s4) &

            !is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$ef001s3) |
            !is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$ef001s4) |
            !is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$ef001s5) |
            !is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$ef001s6) |

            TRUE ~ case_when(
                # 如果所有ef002相关变量都是NA，返回NA
                is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$ef002_1_) & 
                is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$ef002_2_) & 
                is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$ef002_3_) &
                is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$ef002_4_) & 
                is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$ef002_5_) & 
                is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$ef002_6_) ~ NA_real_,
                # 如果任意一个ef002相关变量为1，返回1
                my_data_manual_filtered$ef002_1_ == 1 |
                my_data_manual_filtered$ef002_2_ == 1 |
                my_data_manual_filtered$ef002_3_ == 1 |
                my_data_manual_filtered$ef002_4_ == 1 |
                my_data_manual_filtered$ef002_5_ == 1 |
                my_data_manual_filtered$ef002_6_ == 1 ~ 1,
                # 其他情况返回0
                TRUE ~ 0
            )
        )
    )
```

```{r 疾病情况计算}
# 计算慢性病总数（没问题）
my_data_calculated <- my_data_calculated %>%
    mutate(
        number_chronic_disease = case_when(
            # 如果所有慢性病变量都是NA，返回NA
            is.na(hypertension) & 
            is.na(dyslipidemia) & 
            is.na(diabetes) & 
            is.na(cancer) & 
            is.na(chronic_lung_disease) & 
            is.na(liver_disease) & 
            is.na(heart_disease) & 
            is.na(stroke) & 
            is.na(kidney_disease) & 
            is.na(digestive_system_disease) & 
            is.na(emotional_and_mental_issues) & 
            is.na(diseases_related_to_memory) & 
            is.na(diseases_arthritis) & 
            is.na(asthma) ~ NA_real_,
            # 否则计算非NA值的总和
            TRUE ~ rowSums(
                select(., hypertension, dyslipidemia, diabetes,
                       cancer, chronic_lung_disease, liver_disease,
                       heart_disease, stroke, kidney_disease,
                       digestive_system_disease, emotional_and_mental_issues,
                       diseases_related_to_memory, diseases_arthritis,
                       asthma),
                na.rm = TRUE
            )
        )
    )

# 计算癌症治疗情况（没问题）
my_data_calculated <- my_data_calculated %>%
    mutate(
        treat_cancer = factor(
            case_when(
                cancer == 0 ~ 0,  # 如果没有癌症，则为0
                TRUE ~ case_when(  # 如果有癌症，根据da018s1-6判断
                    is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$da018s1) &
                    is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$da018s2) &
                    is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$da018s3) &
                    is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$da018s4) &
                    is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$da018s5) &
                    is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$da018s6) ~ 2,  # 如果所有变量都是NA，则为2
                    !is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$da018s1) |
                    !is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$da018s2) |
                    !is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$da018s3) |
                    !is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$da018s4) |
                    !is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$da018s5) |
                    !is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$da018s6) ~ 1,  # 如果任一变量非NA，则为1
                    TRUE ~ NA_real_  # 其他情况记为NA
                )
            ),
            levels = c(0, 1, 2),
            labels = c("无癌症", "有癌症且治疗", "有癌症不治疗")
        )
    )
attr(my_data_calculated$treat_cancer, "label") <- "癌症治疗情况"
table(my_data_calculated$treat_cancer, useNA = "ifany")

# 计算癌症总数（没问题）
my_data_calculated <- my_data_calculated %>%
    mutate(
        number_cancer = case_when(
            # 如果所有癌症变量都是NA，返回NA
            is.na(cancer_brain) & 
            is.na(cancer_mouth) & 
            is.na(cancer_larynx) & 
            is.na(cancer_pharynx) & 
            is.na(cancer_thyroid) & 
            is.na(cancer_lung) & 
            is.na(cancer_breast) & 
            is.na(cancer_esophagus) & 
            is.na(cancer_stomach) & 
            is.na(cancer_liver) & 
            is.na(cancer_pancreas) & 
            is.na(cancer_kidney) & 
            is.na(cancer_prostate) & 
            is.na(cancer_testis) & 
            is.na(cancer_ovary) & 
            is.na(cancer_cervix) & 
            is.na(cancer_endometrium) & 
            is.na(cancer_colorectal) & 
            is.na(cancer_bladder) & 
            is.na(cancer_skin) & 
            is.na(cancer_non_hodgkin_lymphoma) & 
            is.na(cancer_leukemia) & 
            is.na(cancer_other) ~ NA_real_,
            # 否则计算非NA值的总和
            TRUE ~ rowSums(
                select(., cancer_brain, cancer_mouth, cancer_larynx,
                       cancer_pharynx, cancer_thyroid, cancer_lung,
                       cancer_breast, cancer_esophagus, cancer_stomach,
                       cancer_liver, cancer_pancreas, cancer_kidney,
                       cancer_prostate, cancer_testis, cancer_ovary,
                       cancer_cervix, cancer_endometrium, cancer_colorectal,
                       cancer_bladder, cancer_skin, cancer_non_hodgkin_lymphoma,
                       cancer_leukemia, cancer_other),
                na.rm = TRUE
            )
        )
    )
attr(my_data_calculated$number_cancer, "label") <- "癌症总数"
table(my_data_calculated$number_cancer, useNA = "ifany")

                my_data_manual_filtered$da027 == 1 | my_data_manual_filtered$zda027 == 1 ~ 1,  # 任一为1则记为1（绝经）
                my_data_manual_filtered$da027 == 2 | my_data_manual_filtered$zda027 == 2 ~ 0,  # 任一为2则记为0（未绝经）

# 计算前列腺疾病情况（没问题）
my_data_calculated <- my_data_calculated %>%
    mutate(
        prostate_illness = case_when(
            gender == "女" ~ 0,  # 女性记为0
            gender == "男" ~ case_when(  # 男性则继续判断
                my_data_manual_filtered$da029 == 1 | my_data_manual_filtered$da029_w2_1 == 1 ~ 1,  # 任一为1则记为1
                (my_data_manual_filtered$da029 == 2 & my_data_manual_filtered$da029_w2_1 != 1) |
                (my_data_manual_filtered$da029_w2_1 == 2 & my_data_manual_filtered$da029 != 1) ~ 0,  # 一个是2另一个不是1则记为0
                TRUE ~ NA_real_  # 其他情况（都为NA）记为NA
            ),
            TRUE ~ NA_real_  # 其他情况记为NA
        )
    )

# 计算前列腺疾病年限（没问题）
my_data_calculated <- my_data_calculated %>%
    mutate(
        prostate_illness_age = case_when(
            prostate_illness == 0 ~ 0,  # 如果没有前列腺疾病，年限为0
            prostate_illness == 1 ~ case_when(
                # 如果da030_1和da030_2都为NA，返回NA
                is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$da030_1) & 
                is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$da030_2) ~ NA_real_,
                # 否则计算年限，优先使用da030_1
                !is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$da030_1) ~ 2015 - my_data_manual_filtered$da030_1,
                !is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$da030_2) ~ age - my_data_manual_filtered$da030_2,
                TRUE ~ NA_real_
            ),
            TRUE ~ NA_real_
        )
    )

my_data_calculated <- my_data_calculated %>%
    mutate(
        treat_prostate_illness = factor(
            case_when(
                prostate_illness == 0 ~ 0,  # 如果没有前列腺疾病，记为0
                prostate_illness == 1 & my_data_manual_filtered$da031 == 1 ~ 1,  # 有病且治疗记为1
                prostate_illness == 1 & my_data_manual_filtered$da031 == 2 ~ 2,  # 有病但未治疗记为2
                TRUE ~ NA_real_  # 其他情况记为NA
            ),
            levels = c(0, 1, 2),
            labels = c("无前列腺疾病", "有前列腺疾病且治疗", "有前列腺疾病不治疗")
        )
    )

            # 如果任一变量为1，返回1

            (my_data_manual_filtered$zda035 == 2 &

            (my_data_manual_filtered$da035 == 2 &

            # 其他情况返回NA

                !is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$da042s15) ~ 1,  # 有颈痛记为1
                TRUE ~ 0  # 其他情况记为0
            )
        )
    )

table(my_data_calculated$pain_neck, useNA = "ifany")

# 计算其他部位疼痛情况（没问题）
my_data_calculated <- my_data_calculated %>%
    mutate(
        pain_other = case_when(
            pain == 0 ~ 0,  # 如果没有疼痛，记为0
            TRUE ~ case_when(  # 如果有疼痛，根据da042s16判断
                !is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$da042s16) ~ 1,  # 有其他部位痛记为1
                TRUE ~ 0  # 其他情况记为0
            )
        )
    )
attr(my_data_calculated$pain_other, "label") <- "其他部位疼痛"
table(my_data_calculated$pain_other, useNA = "ifany")

# 计算疼痛部位总数（没问题）
my_data_calculated <- my_data_calculated %>%
    mutate(
        number_pain_locations = case_when(
            # 如果所有疼痛变量都是NA，返回NA
            is.na(pain_head) & is.na(pain_shoulder) & is.na(pain_arm) & 
            is.na(pain_wrist) & is.na(pain_fingers) & is.na(pain_chest) & 
            is.na(pain_stomach) & is.na(pain_back) & is.na(pain_waist) & 
            is.na(pain_buttocks) & is.na(pain_leg) & is.na(pain_knees) & 
            is.na(pain_ankle) & is.na(pain_toes) & is.na(pain_neck) & 
            is.na(pain_other) ~ NA_real_,
            # 否则计算非NA值的总和
            TRUE ~ rowSums(
                select(., starts_with("pain_")),
                na.rm = TRUE
            )
        )
    )
attr(my_data_calculated$number_pain_locations, "label") <- "疼痛部位总数"
table(my_data_calculated$number_pain_locations, useNA = "ifany")

# 计算疼痛治疗情况
my_data_calculated <- my_data_calculated %>%
    mutate(
        treat_pain = factor(
            case_when(
                pain == 0 ~ 0,  # 如果没有疼痛，则为0
                pain == 1 ~ case_when(  # 如果有疼痛，则继续判断
                    # 如果所有治疗相关变量都是NA，返回2
                    all(is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$da042_w2_1s1),
                        is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$da042_w2_1s2),
                        is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$da042_w2_1s3),
                        is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$da042_w2_1s4),
                        is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$da042_w2_1s5),
                        is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$da042_w2_1s6)) ~ 2,
                    # 如果任一治疗变量不为NA，返回1
                    !is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$da042_w2_1s1) |
                    !is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$da042_w2_1s2) |
                    !is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$da042_w2_1s3) |
                    !is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$da042_w2_1s4) |
                    !is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$da042_w2_1s5) |
                    !is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$da042_w2_1s6) ~ 1,
                    TRUE ~ NA_real_  # 其他情况返回NA
                ),
                TRUE ~ NA_real_  # 其他情况返回NA
            ),
            levels = c(0, 1, 2),
            labels = c("无疼痛", "有疼痛且治疗", "有疼痛不治疗")
        )
    )
attr(my_data_calculated$treat_pain, "label") <- "疼痛治疗情况"
```

```{r 行为习惯计算}
            drink %in% c(1,2) ~ case_when(  # 喝酒则继续判断
                # 如果所有饮酒类型相关变量都是NA，返回NA
                all(is.na(select(my_data_manual_filtered, 
                    da068s1, da068s2, da068s3))) ~ NA_real_,
                !is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$da068s2) ~ 1,  # 喝啤酒记为1
                TRUE ~ 0  # 其他情况记为0
            ),
            TRUE ~ NA_real_
        )
    )
attr(my_data_calculated$type_drink_beer, "label") <- "是否喝啤酒"
table(my_data_calculated$type_drink_beer, useNA = "ifany")

# 计算葡萄酒饮酒情况（没问题）
my_data_calculated <- my_data_calculated %>%
    mutate(
        type_drink_wine = case_when(
            drink == 0 ~ 0,  # 不喝酒则为0
            drink %in% c(1,2) ~ case_when(  # 喝酒则继续判断
                # 如果所有饮酒类型相关变量都是NA，返回NA
                all(is.na(select(my_data_manual_filtered, 
                    da068s1, da068s2, da068s3))) ~ NA_real_,
                !is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$da068s3) ~ 1,  # 喝葡萄酒记为1
                TRUE ~ 0  # 其他情况记为0
            ),
            TRUE ~ NA_real_
        )
    )
attr(my_data_calculated$type_drink_wine, "label") <- "是否喝葡萄酒"
table(my_data_calculated$type_drink_wine, useNA = "ifany")

# 计算饮酒状态（没问题）
my_data_calculated <- my_data_calculated %>%
    mutate(
        drink_status = factor(
            case_when(
                drink == 0 ~ 0,  # 不喝酒记为0
                drink %in% c(1,2) & !is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$da070) ~ 1,  # 饮酒已戒记为1
                drink %in% c(1,2) & is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$da070) ~ 2,  # 饮酒未戒记为2
                TRUE ~ NA_real_  # 其他情况记为NA
            ),
            levels = c(0, 1, 2),
            labels = c("不饮酒", "饮酒已戒", "饮酒未戒")
        )
    )
attr(my_data_calculated$drink_status, "label") <- "饮酒状态"
table(my_data_calculated$drink_status, useNA = "ifany")

# 计算饮酒年数（没问题）
my_data_calculated <- my_data_calculated %>%
    mutate(
        year_drink = case_when(
            drink == 0 ~ 0,  # 不喝酒则年数为0
            TRUE ~ case_when(
                # 如果da071_1不为NA,计算2015-da071_1
                !is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$da071_1) ~ 2015 - my_data_manual_filtered$da071_1,
                # 如果da071_2不为NA,计算age-da071_2
                !is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$da071_2) ~ age - my_data_manual_filtered$da071_2,
                # 两者都为NA则返回NA
                TRUE ~ NA_real_
            )
        )
    )
attr(my_data_calculated$year_drink, "label") <- "饮酒年数"
table(my_data_calculated$year_drink, useNA = "ifany")

# 计算白酒饮酒频率（没问题）

            TRUE ~ case_when(  # 喝白酒则根据da072判断频率
                my_data_manual_filtered$da072 == 1 ~ 1,
                my_data_manual_filtered$da072 == 2 ~ 2,
                my_data_manual_filtered$da072 == 3 ~ 3,
                my_data_manual_filtered$da072 == 4 ~ 4,
                my_data_manual_filtered$da072 == 5 ~ 5,
                my_data_manual_filtered$da072 == 6 ~ 6,
                my_data_manual_filtered$da072 == 7 ~ 7,
                my_data_manual_filtered$da072 == 8 ~ 8,
                TRUE ~ NA_real_
            )
        )
    )

table(my_data_calculated$frequency_drink_liquor, useNA = "ifany")

attr(my_data_calculated$much_drink_liquor, "label") <- "白酒饮酒量"

# 计算啤酒饮酒量（没问题）

    mutate(
        much_drink_beer = case_when(
            type_drink_beer == 0 ~ 0,  # 不喝啤酒则饮酒量为0
            TRUE ~ case_when(
                # 如果da075_1和da075_2都是NA，返回NA
                is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$da075_1) & 
                is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$da075_2) ~ NA_real_,
                # 否则计算da075_1*3+da075_2，忽略NA值
                TRUE ~ coalesce(my_data_manual_filtered$da075_1 * 3, 0) + 
                       coalesce(my_data_manual_filtered$da075_2, 0)
            )
        )
    )
attr(my_data_calculated$much_drink_beer, "label") <- "啤酒饮酒量"

        # 社交相关
        number_social_activities, social_isolation,
        internet_use, devices_internet_use,
        frequency_social_activities,
        
        # 吸烟相关
        smoke, type_smoke_pipe, type_smoke_self_rolled_cigarette,
        type_smoke_filtered_cigarette, type_smoke_unfiltered_cigarette,
        type_smoke_cigar, type_smoke_water_cigarette,
        status_smoke, number_smoke, year_smoke,
        
        # 饮酒相关
        drink, type_drink_liqor, type_drink_beer, type_drink_wine,
        drink_status, year_drink,
        frequency_drink_liquor, frequency_drink_beer, frequency_drink_wine,
        much_drink_liquor, much_drink_beer, much_drink_wine
    )
```

## 缺失值筛选
```{r 缺失值筛选及处理}
# 计算每个变量的缺失值比例
na_proportions <- colMeans(is.na(preprocessed_data))

# 找出缺失值比例超过20%的变量
high_na_vars <- names(na_proportions[na_proportions > 0.2])

# 打印这些变量及其缺失值比例
print("缺失值比例超过20%的变量:")
for(var in high_na_vars) {
  print(paste(var, ":", round(na_proportions[var] * 100, 2), "%"))}

# 去除缺失值超过20%的变量
my_data_na_filtered <- preprocessed_data %>%
    select_if(~sum(is.na(.)) / nrow(preprocessed_data) <= 0.2)

# 查看缺失值筛选后的数据框的维度
dim(my_data_na_filtered)

# 导出缺失值筛选后的数据
# 导出为parquet格式
write_parquet(my_data_na_filtered, "data_export/data_calculated/my_data_na_filtered.parquet")
# 导出为csv格式
write.csv(my_data_na_filtered, "data_export/data_calculated/my_data_na_filtered.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# 查看各变量的插补方法
initial_mice <- mice(my_data_na_filtered, maxit = 0)
method_vector <- initial_mice$method

# 为education_level指定pmm方法
method_vector["education_level"] <- "pmm"
method_vector["traffic_accident_major_accidental_injury"] <- "cart"
method_vector["fractured_hip"] <- "cart"

imputed_data <- mice(my_data_na_filtered, 
                    m = 5,           # 减少插补次数（默认5次）
                    maxit = 50,      # 减少最大迭代次数（默认50次）
                    seed = 123,
                    method = method_vector)     

# 将插补后的数据存入新的数据框
my_data_imputed <- complete(imputed_data, 1)

# 计算每个变量的缺失值数量并按从多到少排序
missing_counts <- sapply(my_data_imputed, function(x) sum(is.na(x)))
missing_counts_sorted <- sort(missing_counts, decreasing = TRUE)
# 创建一个包含变量名和缺失值数量的数据框
missing_df <- data.frame(
  variable = names(missing_counts_sorted),
  missing_count = missing_counts_sorted,
  missing_percentage = round(missing_counts_sorted / nrow(my_data_imputed) * 100, 2)
)
missing_df

# 对self_payfor_inpatientcare、treat_pain和self_treatment进行二次插补

mice_obj2 <- mice(my_data_imputed[, c("self_payfor_inpatientcare", "treat_pain")], m = 5, maxit = 50, method = "pmm", seed = 123)

# 获取插补结果
imputed_data2 <- complete(mice_obj2)

# 将插补结果更新到原数据框中
my_data_imputed$self_payfor_inpatientcare <- imputed_data2$self_payfor_inpatientcare
my_data_imputed$treat_pain <- imputed_data2$treat_pain

# 将self_treatment的缺失值赋值为1
my_data_imputed$self_treatment[is.na(my_data_imputed$self_treatment)] <- 1

# 检查是否还有缺失值
missing_values <- colSums(is.na(my_data_imputed[, c("self_payfor_inpatientcare", "treat_pain", "self_treatment")]))
```

## 组间比较与相关性分析
### 读取变量列表
```{r 读取变量列表}
# 定义文件路径
var_desc_path <- "data_export/descriptive_stats/variables_descriptive.xlsx"

# 读取变量描述文件
cat("读取变量描述文件...\n")
if (file.exists(var_desc_path)) {
  var_types <- read_excel(var_desc_path)
  cat(paste0("成功读取", var_desc_path, "，共包含", nrow(var_types), "个变量\n"))
} else {
  cat(paste0(var_desc_path, "文件不存在，请确认文件路径\n"))
  quit(status = 1)
}
```

### 组间比较
```{r 组间比较}
# 从variables_descriptive.xlsx中提取ordered factor类型变量
factor_vars <- var_types %>%
  filter(type == "factor") %>%
  pull(variable)

cat(paste0("找到", length(factor_vars), "个factor类型变量\n"))

# 提取factor变量和IC总分
factor_data <- my_data_imputed %>% select(c(factor_vars, "ic_total_score"))

# 创建存储结果的列表
group_comparison_results <- list()
significant_results <- list()

# 对每个factor变量进行组间比较
for(var in factor_vars) {
  
  cat(paste0("\n=== 分析变量: ", var, " ===\n"))
  
  # 获取变量标签
  var_label <- var
  
  if(length(var_label) == 0) var_label <- var
  
  # 提取当前变量的数据
  current_data <- factor_data %>%
    select(!!sym(var), ic_total_score) %>%
    filter(!is.na(!!sym(var))) %>%
    mutate(group = as.factor(!!sym(var)))
    
  # 检查组别数量
  n_groups <- length(unique(current_data$group))
  group_sizes <- table(current_data$group)
  
  cat(paste0("变量标签: ", var_label, "\n"))
  cat(paste0("组别数量: ", n_groups, "\n"))
  cat("各组样本量:\n")
  print(group_sizes)
  
  # 进行非参数检验
  # 如果组别数量小于2，跳过
  if(n_groups < 2) {
    cat("组别数量不足，跳过分析\n")
    next
  }
  if(n_groups == 2) {
    # 两组比较：Mann-Whitney U检验（Wilcoxon秩和检验）
    test_result <- wilcox.test(ic_total_score ~ group, data = current_data)
    test_name <- "Mann-Whitney U检验"
    test_statistic <- test_result$statistic
    p_value <- test_result$p.value
    
  } else {
    # 多组比较：Kruskal-Wallis检验
    test_result <- kruskal.test(ic_total_score ~ group, data = current_data)
    test_name <- "Kruskal-Wallis检验"
    test_statistic <- test_result$statistic
    p_value <- test_result$p.value
  }
  
  cat(paste0("\n", test_name, "结果:\n"))
  cat(paste0("统计量: ", round(test_statistic, 4), "\n"))
  cat(paste0("p值: ", format(p_value, scientific = TRUE, digits = 3), "\n"))
  
  # 判断显著性
  significance <- ifelse(p_value < 0.001, "***", 
                        ifelse(p_value < 0.01, "**",
                              ifelse(p_value < 0.05, "*", "ns")))
  
  cat(paste0("显著性: ", significance, "\n"))
  
  # 存储结果
  result_summary <- data.frame(
    变量 = var,
    变量标签 = var_label,
    组别数 = n_groups,
    总样本量 = nrow(current_data),
    检验方法 = test_name,
    统计量 = round(test_statistic, 4),
    P值 = p_value,
    显著性 = significance,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  group_comparison_results[[var]] <- list(
    summary = result_summary,
    descriptive_stats = desc_stats,
    test_result = test_result,
    data = current_data
  )
  
  # 如果显著，加入显著结果列表
  if(p_value < 0.05) {
    significant_results[[var]] <- group_comparison_results[[var]]
  }
}

# 合并所有结果
all_results_summary <- do.call(rbind, lapply(group_comparison_results, function(x) x$summary))

cat(paste0("\n=== 组间比较分析完成 ===\n"))
cat(paste0("总共分析了 ", nrow(all_results_summary), " 个factor变量\n"))
cat(paste0("其中显著差异的变量有 ", length(significant_results), " 个\n"))

# 显示结果汇总表
knitr::kable(all_results_summary, 
             caption = "Factor变量IC总分组间比较结果汇总",
             digits = c(0,0,0,0,0,4,6,0))

# 创建Excel工作簿
wb <- createWorkbook()

# 添加结果汇总表
addWorksheet(wb, "组间比较汇总")
writeData(wb, "组间比较汇总", all_results_summary)

# 为每个显著差异的变量添加详细结果
if(length(significant_results) > 0) {
  for(var in names(significant_results)) {
    # 添加描述性统计工作表
    sheet_name <- paste0(substr(var, 1, 25), "_描述统计")
    addWorksheet(wb, sheet_name)
    writeData(wb, sheet_name, significant_results[[var]]$descriptive_stats)
  }
}

# 添加所有变量的描述性统计
addWorksheet(wb, "所有变量描述统计")
all_desc_stats <- list()
for(var in names(group_comparison_results)) {
  desc_with_var <- group_comparison_results[[var]]$descriptive_stats %>%
    mutate(变量 = var, .before = 1)
  all_desc_stats[[var]] <- desc_with_var
}
all_desc_combined <- do.call(rbind, all_desc_stats)
writeData(wb, "所有变量描述统计", all_desc_combined)

# 保存工作簿
saveWorkbook(wb, "data_export/model_results/tables/factor_variables_group_comparison_results.xlsx", 
             overwrite = TRUE)

cat("\n=== 分析完成 ===\n")
cat("结果已保存到:\n")
cat("- 表格: data_export/model_results/tables/factor_variables_group_comparison_results.xlsx\n")
if(length(significant_results) > 0) {
  cat("- 图形: data_export/model_results/figures/factor_variables_ic_group_comparison.png\n")
}
cat(paste0("共分析了 ", length(factor_vars), " 个factor变量\n"))
cat(paste0("发现 ", length(significant_results), " 个变量存在显著组间差异\n")) 
```
### 等级变量相关性分析
```{r 等级变量相关性分析}
# 从variables_descriptive.xlsx中提取ordered factor类型变量
ordered_factor_vars <- var_types %>%
  filter(type == "ordered factor") %>%
  pull(variable)

cat(paste0("找到", length(ordered_factor_vars), "个ordered factor类型变量\n"))

# 将ordered factor变量转换为numeric
numeric_data <- my_data_imputed %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(ordered_factor_vars), as.numeric))

# 确保ic_total_score在数据集中
if (!"ic_total_score" %in% names(numeric_data)) {
  cat("错误: 数据集中没有找到'ic_total_score'变量\n")
  quit(status = 1)
}

# 计算Spearman相关性
cat("计算Spearman相关性...\n")
correlations <- data.frame(variable = character(), correlation = numeric(), p_value = numeric())

for (var in ordered_factor_vars) {
  # 计算与ic_total_score的相关性
  corr_test <- cor.test(numeric_data[[var]], numeric_data[["ic_total_score"]], 
                        method = "spearman", exact = FALSE)
  
  correlations <- rbind(correlations, data.frame(
    variable = var,
    correlation = corr_test$estimate,
    p_value = corr_test$p.value
  ))
}

# 按相关性绝对值排序
correlations <- correlations %>% 
  mutate(abs_correlation = abs(correlation)) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs_correlation)) %>%
  select(-abs_correlation)

# 添加显著性标记
correlations <- correlations %>%
  mutate(significance = case_when(
    p_value < 0.001 ~ "***",
    p_value < 0.01 ~ "**",
    p_value < 0.05 ~ "*",
    TRUE ~ ""
  ))

# 打印相关性结果
print(correlations)

# 保存相关性结果到文件
write_xlsx(correlations, "data_export/descriptive_stats/ic_ordered_factor_correlations.xlsx")
cat("已保存相关性分析结果到ic_oredered_factor_correlations.xlsx\n")

# 可视化相关性结果
cat("生成相关性可视化...\n")
top_corrs <- head(correlations, 20)  # 取相关性最高的20个变量

p <- ggplot(top_corrs, aes(x = correlation, y = reorder(variable, correlation))) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "steelblue") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Top 20 Factor Variables Correlated with ic_total_score (Spearman)",
       x = "Correlation",
       y = "Variable") +
  geom_text(aes(label = significance), hjust = -0.5)
print(p)

# 输出相关性最强的10个变量
cat("\n相关性最强的10个变量：\n")
print(head(correlations, 10))

cat("\n分析完成！\n")

```

## 算法筛选
### RFE算法筛选
```{r RFE算法筛选}
# 设置RFE控制参数
set.seed(123) # 设置随机种子以确保结果可重复
rfeControl <- rfeControl(
    functions = rfFuncs, # 使用随机森林作为基础模型
    method = "cv",       # 使用交叉验证
    number = 5,         # 5折交叉验证
    verbose = TRUE      # 输出详细信息
)
# 定义预测变量
predictors <- my_data_imputed %>%
    select(-ic_total_score, -ID)
# 准备数据
# 移除不需要的列（如ID等）并处理缺失值
# 执行RFE
rfe_result <- rfe(
    x = predictors,
    y = my_data_imputed$ic_total_score,
    sizes = seq(5, ncol(predictors), by = 5), # 尝试不同数量的特征
    rfeControl = rfeControl
)
# 查看结果
print(rfe_result)
str(rfe_result)

# 获取最佳特征子集
variables_rfe_filter <- data.frame(Variables = rfe_result$optVariables)

# 将结果保存到CSV文件
write.csv(variables_rfe_filter, "data_export/data_auto_filter/variables_rfe_filter.csv",row.names = FALSE)
```
### ETC算法筛选
```{r ETC算法筛选}
# 使用ranger包实现ETC算法
etc_model <- ranger(
  formula = ic_total_score ~ . - ID, 
  data = my_data_imputed,
  importance = 'impurity',
  num.trees = 500,
  mtry = floor(sqrt(ncol(my_data_imputed) - 1))
)
str(etc_model)

# 获取变量重要性得分
var_importance <- etc_model$variable.importance  # 直接从模型对象中获取变量重要性
var_importance_df <- data.frame(
  Variable = names(var_importance),
  Importance = var_importance
)

# 按重要性排序
var_importance_df <- var_importance_df[order(var_importance_df$Importance, decreasing = TRUE), ]

# 选择重要性得分大于平均值的变量
mean_importance <- mean(var_importance_df$Importance)
selected_vars <- var_importance_df$Variable[var_importance_df$Importance > mean_importance]

# 输出筛选后的变量
print("Selected variables:")
print(selected_vars)

# 将选定的变量列表导出为CSV文件
variables_etc_filter <- data.frame(
  Variable_Name = selected_vars,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# 导出变量列表到csv
write.csv(variables_etc_filter, 
          "data_export/data_auto_filter/variables_etc_filter.csv", 
          row.names = FALSE,
          fileEncoding = "UTF-8")

```
### MI算法进行筛选
```{r MI算法筛选}
# 准备数据：移除ID列并处理数据
data_for_mi <- my_data_imputed %>%
  select(-ID) %>%  # 去掉ID列
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), function(x) {
    # 排除ID列和其他不需要离散化的特殊列
    if(all(x %in% c(0, 1, NA))) {
      return(x)  # 如果是二值变量，保持原样
    } else {
      # 使用cut函数进行离散化，分成10个等宽区间
      cut(x, breaks = 10, labels = FALSE, include.lowest = TRUE)
    }
  }))
# 计算每个变量与总分之间的互信息
mi_scores <- sapply(names(data_for_mi), function(x) {
    if(x != "ic_total_score") {
        mutinformation(data_for_mi[[x]], data_for_mi$ic_total_score)
    } else {
        NA
    }
})

# 创建变量重要性数据框
var_importance_df <- data.frame(
    Variable = names(data_for_mi),
    MI_Score = mi_scores
) %>%
    filter(!is.na(MI_Score)) %>%
    arrange(desc(MI_Score))

# 选择互信息得分大于平均值的变量
mean_mi_score <- mean(var_importance_df$MI_Score)
variables_mi_filter <- data.frame(Variable_Name = var_importance_df$Variable[var_importance_df$MI_Score > mean_mi_score])
# 将筛选结果导出到csv文件
write.csv(variables_mi_filter, "data_export/data_auto_filter/variables_mi_filter.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```
### Boruta算法筛选
```{r Boruta算法筛选}
# 检查因子变量的水平数量
single_level_factors <- sapply(my_data_imputed, function(x) {
  if (is.factor(x)) length(levels(x)) == 1 else FALSE
})

# 打印只有一个水平的因子变量
print(names(single_level_factors[single_level_factors]))

# 移除只有一个水平的因子变量
my_data_imputed <- my_data_imputed %>%
  select(-all_of(names(single_level_factors[single_level_factors])))
dim(my_data_imputed)

# 使用Boruta算法进行变量筛选
set.seed(123)

# 运行Boruta算法
boruta_output <- Boruta(ic_total_score ~ . - ID, data = my_data_imputed, doTrace = 2)

# 获取确定纳入的变量
confirmed_vars <- names(boruta_output$finalDecision[boruta_output$finalDecision == "Confirmed"])
print("确定纳入的变量:")
print(confirmed_vars)
length(confirmed_vars)

# 获取可能纳入的变量
tentative_vars <- names(boruta_output$finalDecision[boruta_output$finalDecision == "Tentative"])
print("可能纳入的变量:")
print(tentative_vars)
length(tentative_vars)

# 获取确定排除的变量
rejected_vars <- names(boruta_output$finalDecision[boruta_output$finalDecision == "Rejected"])
print("确定排除的变量:")
print(rejected_vars)

# 从插值后数据框中提取确认纳入和可能纳入的变量
# 创建一个数据框来存储变量信息
variables_boruta_filter <- data.frame(
  variable_name = c(confirmed_vars, tentative_vars),
  status = c(rep("确认纳入", length(confirmed_vars)), 
             rep("可能纳入", length(tentative_vars)))
)

# 导出变量信息到CSV文件
write.csv(vars_info, 
          "data_export/data_auto_filter/variables_boruta_filter.csv", 
          row.names = FALSE,
          fileEncoding = "UTF-8")

```

## 建模及验证
### 建模前预处理
```{r 建模前预处理}
# 从common_data数据中筛选VIF筛选后的变量
model_data <- common_data %>%
    select(
        all_of(rownames(as.data.frame(vif_results_after_filter))),
        ic_total_score
    )

# 查看建模前数据框的维度
dim(model_data)
str(model_data)

# 给识字变量不同分类添加标签
model_data$literate <- factor(model_data$literate, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("不识字", "识字"))

# 去除变量标签
for(col in names(model_data)) {
    attr(model_data[[col]], "label") <- NULL
}

# 去除变量的stata标签
attributes(model_data$hematocrit)$format.stata <- NULL
attributes(model_data$waist_circumference)$format.stata <- NULL
attributes(model_data$triglycerides)$format.stata <- NULL
attributes(model_data$uric_acid)$format.stata <- NULL

str(model_data)

# 对建模前数据进行label encoding
order_vars <- names(model_data)[sapply(model_data, is.ordered)]

# 使用mutate_at转换指定的变量
model_data <- model_data %>%
    mutate_at(vars(all_of(order_vars)), as.numeric)

# 将建模数据导出为parquet格式
write_parquet(model_data, "data_export/model_data/model_data.parquet")

# 设置随机种子并分割数据
set.seed(123)
split <- initial_split(model_data, prop = 0.7)
ic_train <- training(split)
ic_test <- testing(split)
ic_test$martial_status[ic_test$martial_status == "同居"] <- "从未结婚"
write.csv(ic_train, "data_export/model_data/ic_train.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(ic_test, "data_export/model_data/ic_test.csv", row.names = FALSE)


```

### 多元线性回归
```{r 多元线性回归}
# 蓝图构建
blueprint_lm <- recipe(ic_total_score ~ ., data = ic_train) %>%
  step_nzv(all_nominal()) %>%
  step_dummy(all_nominal(), -all_outcomes(), one_hot = TRUE)

# 设置交叉验证参数
ctrl_lm <- trainControl(
    method = "repeatedcv", 
    number = 10, 
    repeats = 5,
    verboseIter = TRUE     
)
# 构建多元线性回归模型
lm_fit <- train(
  blueprint_lm,
  data = ic_train,
  method = "lm", 
  trControl = ctrl_lm
)

# 查看模型的性能
print(lm_fit)

# 查看多元线性回归模型的详细信息
summary(lm_fit$finalModel)

# 使用多元线性回归模型进行预测
lm_predictions <- predict(lm_fit, newdata = ic_test)

# 计算均方误差（MSE）
lm_mse <- mean((lm_predictions - ic_test$ic_total_score)^2)
print(paste("多元线性回归模型的测试集MSE:", lm_mse))

# 计算均方根误差（RMSE）
lm_rmse <- sqrt(lm_mse)
print(paste("多元线性回归模型的测试集RMSE:", lm_rmse))

# 计算平均绝对误差（MAE）
lm_mae <- mean(abs(lm_predictions - ic_test$ic_total_score))
print(paste("多元线性回归模型的测试集MAE:", lm_mae))
```

```{r 建模结果导出}
              ", colsample_bytree =", xgb_fit$bestTune$colsample_bytree,
              ", min_child_weight =", xgb_fit$bestTune$min_child_weight,
              ", subsample =", xgb_fit$bestTune$subsample)
    )
)

# 写入模型参数
writeData(wb_performance, "Model Parameters", model_parameters)

# 设置列宽
setColWidths(wb_performance, "Model Parameters", cols = 1:2, widths = c(15, 50))

# 添加模型性能工作表
addWorksheet(wb_performance, "Model Performance")

# 创建模型性能数据框
model_performance <- data.frame(
    Model = c("Linear Regression", "KNN", "Random Forest", "SVM", "ANN", "XGBoost"),
    Train_MSE = c(

    ),

        min(svm_fit$results$RMSE),

        min(xgb_fit$results$RMSE)
    ),
    Train_MAE = c(
        min(lm_fit$results$MAE),
        min(knn_fit$results$MAE),
        min(rf_fit$results$MAE),
        min(svm_fit$results$MAE),
        min(ann_fit$results$MAE),

    ),
```  

### 所有模型结果可视化
```{r 所有模型结果可视化}
# 绘制6个模型的变量重要性图
# 创建一个函数来提取每个模型的变量重要性分数
get_importance_scores <- function(model, model_name) {
  imp <- vip::vi(model)
  imp$model <- model_name
  return(imp)
}

# 获取变量标签
get_label_or_name <- function(var_name) {
  label <- attr(model_data[[var_name]], "label")
  return(ifelse(is.null(label), var_name, label))
}

# 修改变量重要性数据框中的变量名为标签
process_importance <- function(imp_data, model_name) {
  imp <- head(get_importance_scores(imp_data, model_name), 20)
  imp$Variable <- sapply(imp$Variable, get_label_or_name)
  return(imp)
}

# 获取每个模型的变量重要性
# 获取每个模型的变量重要性并按重要性排序
lm_imp <- get_importance_scores(lm_fit, "Linear Regression") %>%
  arrange(desc(Importance)) %>%
  head(30)

knn_imp <- get_importance_scores(knn_fit, "KNN") %>%
  arrange(desc(Importance)) %>%
  head(30)

rf_imp <- get_importance_scores(rf_fit, "Random Forest") %>%
  arrange(desc(Importance)) %>%
  head(30)

svm_imp <- get_importance_scores(svm_fit, "SVM") %>%
  arrange(desc(Importance)) %>%
  head(30)

ann_imp <- get_importance_scores(ann_fit, "ANN") %>%
  arrange(desc(Importance)) %>%
  head(30)

xgb_imp <- get_importance_scores(xgb_fit, "XGBoost") %>%
  arrange(desc(Importance)) %>%
  head(30)

# 合并所有模型的变量重要性
all_imp <- rbind(lm_imp, knn_imp, rf_imp, svm_imp, ann_imp, xgb_imp)

# 创建组合图
print(ggplot(all_imp, aes(x = reorder(Variable, Importance), y = Importance)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = model), size = 3) +
  facet_wrap(~model, scales = "free_y") +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Variable Importance Comparison",
    x = "Variables", 
    y = "Importance Score"
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8, family = "SimHei"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(family = "SimHei"),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold", family = "SimHei"),
    plot.title = element_text(family = "SimHei")
  ))

# 保存图片为SVG格式
ggsave("data_export/model_results/figures/variable_importance_comparison.svg", 
       width = 16, height = 8, device = "svg")

# 创建预测值与真实值的散点图
# 准备数据
plot_data <- data.frame(
  Actual = ic_test$ic_total_score,
  LM = predict(lm_fit, newdata = ic_test),
  KNN = predict(knn_fit, newdata = ic_test),
  RF = predict(rf_fit, newdata = ic_test),
  SVM = predict(svm_fit, newdata = ic_test),

)

# 转换为长格式
plot_data_long <- tidyr::pivot_longer(

  )
# 保存图片为SVG
ggsave("data_export/model_results/figures/prediction_vs_actual_comparison.svg",
       width = 16, height = 8, device = "svg", bg = "white")
```

### 计算最佳模型SHAP
```{r 计算最佳模型SHAP}
# 从caret中计算
xgb_model_from_caret <- xgb_fit$finalModel

processed_test <- blueprint_xgb %>% 
  prep() %>% 
  bake(new_data = ic_test)

# 转换为矩阵格式
X_test_matrix <- processed_test %>% 
  select(-ic_total_score) %>% 
  as.matrix()

# 计算SHAP值
if(!exists("shap_contrib_caret")) {
  # 使用predict函数计算SHAP贡献值
  shap_contrib_caret <- predict(xgb_model_from_caret, 
                               newdata = X_test_matrix, 
                               predcontrib = TRUE)
}

# 创建SHAP值数据框
shap_values_df <- as.data.frame(shap_contrib_caret[, -ncol(shap_contrib_caret)])

# 添加变量名称作为列名
colnames(shap_values_df) <- colnames(X_test_matrix)

# 添加行索引（观测ID）
# 将观测id添加到第一列
shap_values_df <- shap_values_df %>%
  mutate(observation_id = 1:nrow(.)) %>%
  select(observation_id, everything())

# 计算每个变量的平均绝对SHAP值
shap_importance <- data.frame(
  variable = colnames(shap_values_df)[-1],  # 排除observation_id列
  mean_abs_shap = colMeans(abs(shap_values_df[,-1])),  # 计算每个变量的平均绝对SHAP值
  mean_shap = colMeans(shap_values_df[,-1])  # 计算每个变量的平均SHAP值
) %>%
  arrange(desc(mean_abs_shap))  # 按重要性降序排列

# 将SHAP值转换为长格式，方便后续可视化
shap_values_long <- shap_values_df %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -observation_id,
    names_to = "variable",
    values_to = "shap_value"
  )

# 创建包含原始值和SHAP值的数据框
# 首先获取原始数据（不包括目标变量）
original_values_df <- as.data.frame(X_test_matrix)

# 创建一个空的数据框来存储交替排列的数据
alternating_df <- data.frame(observation_id = shap_values_df$observation_id)

# 获取所有变量名（不包括observation_id）
variable_names <- colnames(original_values_df)

# 为了区分SHAP值和原始值，给列名添加前缀
shap_values_with_prefix <- shap_values_df[, -which(names(shap_values_df) == "observation_id")]
colnames(shap_values_with_prefix) <- paste0("shap_", colnames(shap_values_with_prefix))

# 对每个变量，添加原始值和对应的SHAP值
for (var in variable_names) {
  alternating_df[[var]] <- original_values_df[[var]]
  alternating_df[[paste0("shap_", var)]] <- shap_values_with_prefix[[paste0("shap_", var)]]
}

# 添加内在能力总分到数据框的最后
alternating_df$ic_total_score <- ic_test$ic_total_score

# 计算XGBoost模型的预测值
alternating_df$xgb_predicted <- xgb_predictions

# 创建一个工作簿并导出所有SHAP相关表格
wb <- createWorkbook()

# 添加SHAP重要性表格到第一个工作表
addWorksheet(wb, "SHAP重要性")
writeData(wb, "SHAP重要性", shap_importance)

# 添加长格式SHAP值到第二个工作表
addWorksheet(wb, "长格式SHAP值")
writeData(wb, "长格式SHAP值", shap_values_long)

# 添加SHAP值到第三个工作表
addWorksheet(wb, "SHAP值")
writeData(wb, "SHAP值", alternating_df)

# 保存工作簿
saveWorkbook(wb, "data_export/model_results/tables/xgboost_shap_results.xlsx", overwrite = TRUE)
```
